question: What do signed covariance, nominal factor diversity and lagged performance allocation imply for risk in observed research-factor returns?
evaluation_months: 2020 through last mechanically complete available month
complete_month_rule: month final available weekday date reaches calendar last weekday; incomplete trailing month excluded without viewing returns
origins: month-end, future next-calendar-month nonoverlapping daily observations
scales: each query uses its previous252 observed daily factor standard deviations; current inverse-volatility factor-sleeve coefficients sum to1
target: mean squared next-month daily fixed-coefficient research-factor combination; not intraday RV or actual funded NAV
full_covariance: previous63days centered covariance plus portfolio mean squared
diagonal: same means and marginal variances, zero cross covariances
covariance_sign: signed cross terms retained; net hedging allowed

allocation.updates: monthly after observed previous-month research returns
allocation.score: previous calendar month cumulative factor return divided by current past252day scale times sqrt(number of completed month days), clipped[-2,2]
allocation.rule: risk-budget softmax update then2%equal-budget reinjection; divide budget by current past volatility and normalize coefficient sum to1
allocation.control: same completed scores with deterministic date-seeded permutation of factor identities
allocation.primary_concentration: sum of squared actual held factor-sleeve coefficients
allocation.cost: gross primary risk; record monthly coefficient turnover and descriptive1bp coefficient-turnover charge; unknown within-factor implementation cost not fabricated
allocation.scope: computed allocation backtest on observed factor returns; not observed fund flows, self-financing institution account or endogenous market impact

HAR.family: positive Gamma log-mean ridge; fit1990-2009 only, penalty selected2010-2019 only, no evaluation refit
HAR.information: both afforded same six-series past252days and same fit/development; representation and capacity differ
HAR.features_all: portfolio HAR, six individual factor second moments each window,63day factor means and15pairwise correlations

bootstrap.p: two-sided centered paired-block null with add-one rule
bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm6 separately at each block size; main block3

scope: historical protocol frozen before this dataset; no prospective or institutional-quant causation claim; no automatic macro-to-trader identification
